translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic hebreo

content: A Dios in tacuy tihua’chic an Israel jita’ quim bijiy ti ts’ale pale’ abal quin t’aja’ ti ts’ejcaclome c’al a Dios ani c’al am bichou Israel. Quin huat’banchi c’al a Dios an ts’ejhualixtalab axi ca binanchat c’al an Israelchic. Jaye quim binanchi c’al a Dios in xits’al i tsemthach co’nel abal ca paculanchat in hualab an Israelchic.
Cum an ts’ale pale’ pelac i inic jaye palu tim ba’, jaxtam in ejtou quin c’aya’na’ axi yab tsalpath ani ouchic in ichich c’al a Dios.
Cum pelac i hualbinel jaye in yejenchi quim bina’ c’al a Dios in xits’al i tsemthach co’nel tin cuenta in cuete’ hualab ani yab expith tin cuenta in hualab in at Israel.
Ti jayq’ui’ ni jita’ tam inic yab in ejtou quin cuete’ bijiy tim ba’ ti ts’ale pale’, cum pel in uchbil a Dios expith quin tacuy ani quim bijiy jitats jaja’ quin le’na’. Ti jayq’ui’ im bijiy a Aarón.
Ani ja’its a Dios ax im bijiy a Cristo ti lej ts’ale pale’ lej c’athpich pulic in uchbil. Jaja’ tin cuete’ tsalap yab im bijiy tim ba’. Uchan c’al a Dios antse’:

content.text: Cum tata’its pel tu lej Tsacamil, jaxtam nan xo’ tu pithamalits a lej uchbil.

content: Uchanaye a Cristo c’al a Dios ani thuchath ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab in cahuintal a Dios antse’:

content.text: Tata’its ne’ets quit c’uajiy abal ets’ey tit pale’.
Nana’ putat tu bijiy jant’ini’ tu bijiy jaye a Melquisedec ti jayq’ui’.

content: Tam ti xe’tsin a Cristo teje’ tsabal in ets’ey mo’camal in conchixtal c’al a Dios ti eb, ma c’al i cau lej tsapic ani ma c’al yan i uq’uil olon. Lej conchixin c’al a Dios ax in ejtohuamalac ti quin jec’ontha’ abal yab ca tsemtha. Ani cum ets’ey lej c’ac’nax c’al a Dios, jaxtam a Dios in lej bina’ in xutsun c’al in conchixtal.
Aba ani’ a Cristo pel in Tsacamil a Dios, bel in lej yajchicnamal ani c’al an yajchictalab más in tso’obnamalits quim putu c’al jahua’ uchbith c’al a Dios quin t’aja’.
Cum in tala’ t’ajchamalits in culbetal a Dios, jats tim baju ti lej jum putat huit’ath Jec’onthax, ani jaxtam in ejtohual quin jec’ontha’ abal ets’ey patal jitats quin t’ajchi jahua’ jaja’ quin ulu.
A Dios putat im bijiy a Cristo ti ts’ale pale’ jant’ini’ ti bijiyat jaye a Melquisedec c’al a Dios.
Am belomchic axi ejtile i t’ele’
Hua’atse yan i cau u le’ac tu olchichic tin cuenta in ey a Cristo ti ts’ale pale’, tocat lej t’ojlab abal nan tu lejquinchi an cau cum lej obe a tsalap.

Ma ohuatits it belom c’al a Cristo ani in lejabac max a bajumalaquits tit exobchix c’al in cahuintal a Dios. Ma a yejenchale quit huilq’uith lejquinchat in cahuintal a Dios axi lej exlantalits ani yab q’uibat. Ejtil it t’eleyechic ani a yejenchale i letsa, ani yabaye a ejtohual ca c’apu i lej te’nel.
Jitats ejtil i lej t’ele’ axi chuchule, yabaye in alhua’ exbayal in cahuintal a Dios ax in olnal jahua’ bolith ani jahua’ yab bolith.

Jitats in cua’al in ichich jum putat payenequits ti eynanchix c’al patal in ey a Cristo in alhua’ exbayalits in luputh in cahuintal a Dios axi ejtil i lej te’nel. Cum lej exobchichithits in ichich c’al in cahuintal a Dios, jaxtam in ujnamits quin exbay jahua’ alhua’ ani jahua’ yab alhua’.
